scene.note: The day's tickets are read into repairs, a bad line is refused by its number, and the totals are written back to a file.

steps.note: One line of the day's tickets arrives, with a repair to fill in.
The line is split and every field is looked at, before anything is filled in.

value.label: comes out
values: whether the line is a repair
the repair, filled in only then

steps.note: A good line fills in the repair; a wrong one leaves it as it was.

value.label: goes in
values: a stream of lines, a heading first

steps.note: The day's tickets arrive as a stream, the heading on top.
Every line after the heading that is not blank is handed over to be read.

value.label: comes out
values: the numbers of the refused lines

steps.note: Good lines become repairs; a bad one is written down by its line number, and the day goes on.
Once the whole day is read, the repairs and the refused lines arrive together.

value.label: the report
values: all the parts, pence and all

steps.note: The totals are worked out, the parts kept with their pence.
Four lines go to whatever stream was handed over.
Ambrose names the day's tickets and where the report goes.
The tickets are opened and read; when they are not there, nothing more happens.
Only then is the report file written, in place of yesterday's.
